typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_folder as string (),
	Archive_location as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Environment as string (),
	Filename as string (),
	Final_Table as string (),
	LookBackTime as integer (),
	LookBackTime_auth as integer (),
	Outbound_Folder as string (),
	Outbound_location as string (),
	Record_count as integer (),
	Template_File as string ()
}

source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_GENDER as string,
		MEMBER_BIRTHDATE as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		MEMBER_RACE as string,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_STATE as string,
		MEMBER_ZIP_CODE as string,
		MEMBER_COUNTY as string,
		MEMBER_EMAIL_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_TYPE as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_PLAN as string,
		MEMBER_PRODUCT as string,
		MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY_STATUS as string,
		DIABETES_DIAG_CODE as string,
		HYPERTENSION_DIAG_CODE as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		PCP_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		PCP_FAX_NUMBER as string,
		OBGYN_NAME as string,
		OBGYN_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		OBGYN_FAX_NUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select SUBSCRIBER_ID  			,MEDICAID_ID  			,MEMBER_FIRST_NAME  			,MEMBER_LAST_NAME  			,MEMBER_GENDER 			,MEMBER_BIRTHDATE  			,MEMBER_AGE 			,MEMBER_RACE  			,MEMBER_LANGUAGE  			,MEMBER_ADDRESS  			,MEMBER_CITY  			,MEMBER_STATE 			,MEMBER_ZIP_CODE  			,MEMBER_COUNTY  			,MEMBER_EMAIL_ADDRESS  			,MEMBER_PHONE_TYPE  			,MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER  			,MEMBER_PLAN  			,MEMBER_PRODUCT  			,MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY_STATUS 			,DIABETES_DIAG_CODE 			,HYPERTENSION_DIAG_CODE 			,PCP_NAME 			,PCP_PHONE_NUMBER 			,PCP_FAX_NUMBER  			,OBGYN_NAME  			,OBGYN_PHONE_NUMBER 			,OBGYN_FAX_NUMBER  from ##GA_MAT_MEM_EXT_FINAL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(MEMBER_ZIP_CODE = MEMBER_ZIP_CODE,
		MEMBER_STATE = MEMBER_STATE,
		MEMBER_PLAN = MEMBER_PLAN,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS = MEMBER_ADDRESS,
		MEMBER_GENDER = MEMBER_GENDER,
		HYPERTENSION_DIAG_CODE = HYPERTENSION_DIAG_CODE,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER = MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		MEMBER_EMAIL_ADDRESS = MEMBER_EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		MEMBER_BIRTHDATE = MEMBER_BIRTHDATE,
		PCP_PHONE_NUMBER = PCP_PHONE_NUMBER,
		MEMBER_RACE = MEMBER_RACE,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE = MEMBER_LANGUAGE,
		PCP_NAME = PCP_NAME,
		MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY_STATUS = MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY_STATUS,
		PCP_FAX_NUMBER = PCP_FAX_NUMBER,
		MEMBER_COUNTY = MEMBER_COUNTY,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		MEDICAID_ID = MEDICAID_ID,
		MEMBER_AGE = MEMBER_AGE,
		OBGYN_FAX_NUMBER = OBGYN_FAX_NUMBER,
		OBGYN_PHONE_NUMBER = OBGYN_PHONE_NUMBER,
		DIABETES_DIAG_CODE = DIABETES_DIAG_CODE,
		MEMBER_PRODUCT = MEMBER_PRODUCT,
		OBGYN_NAME = OBGYN_NAME,
		MEMBER_CITY = MEMBER_CITY,
		MEMBER_PHONE_TYPE = MEMBER_PHONE_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEMBER_RACE as string,
		MEMBER_BIRTHDATE as string,
		MEMBER_ZIP_CODE as string,
		PCP_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_COUNTY as string,
		OBGYN_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_GENDER as string,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE as string,
		MEMBER_EMAIL_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_STATE as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_PRODUCT as string,
		MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY_STATUS as string,
		OBGYN_NAME as string,
		HYPERTENSION_DIAG_CODE as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_TYPE as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		DIABETES_DIAG_CODE as string,
		PCP_FAX_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_PLAN as string,
		OBGYN_FAX_NUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
